principle: Generate persistent biology/morphology from environment and seed before visual styling. Biology constrains bodies; it does not prescribe morality, culture or personality.
rules: Homeworld gravity/atmosphere/temperature and biosphere constrain plausible morphology unless explicit anomaly/provenance explains otherwise.
Do not generate every new species as Human plus forehead appliance.
Do not generate grotesque/extreme morphology merely for novelty.
Biology does not force government, culture, loyalty, aggression, humor, intelligence or ethics.
One civilization may contain multiple sapient species.
One species may belong to multiple civilizations.
Materialized species morphology persists; later art must use same morphology identity.
Unknown biological detail remains unresolved until observation/sample/contact requires it.
visual_boundary: NAP consumes persistent species morphology; image generation cannot redefine biology.
